title: ID0454069-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2/T3 314161484002] DC3 error code 7.4
description:
Reported behavior/issue: DC3 error code 7.4
Solution:
“One or more connected SMC to the converter group has ON or OFF feedback fault (this converter group is disabled and converter group at another end of faulty SMC is probably enabled)”,please proceed with replacing both converters: +F04-QA15 and +F04-QA16.

additional_info.subject: ID0454069-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2/T3 314161484002] DC3 error code 7.4 CRM:03057000026
additional_info.body:
Dear Johannes.
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0454069
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-AT SI E Queue. The first response has been sent to the customer, and we kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer: SI E (Johannes Dissauer)
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2/T3314161484002
Charger ID / Serial No.:
uB5s3D
Charger address/functional location: Austria
Priority:
Medium
Possible solution:
Due to the recurring error code 7.4 in DC3:
“One or more connected SMC to the converter group has ON or OFF feedback fault (this converter group is disabled and converter group at another end of faulty SMC is probably enabled)”,please proceed with replacing both converters: +F04-QA15 and +F04-QA16.
Here is the MLFB for the required part:8EM5903-0AA00-7AA8 – Contactor DC 2P 500A 1200VDC
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-AT SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Calin Ienei
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
